_comment: Behavioural test set for the prompt optimizer. Real-pattern headlines the digest has seen or would plausibly see. must_pass items are unambiguously worth surfacing; must_fail items are the noise the digest exists to filter out. A rewritten prompt that gets these wrong is rejected before it reaches production, regardless of whether it is structurally valid. Several pairs are deliberately contrastive — near-identical setups with opposite outcomes — to pin the exact decision boundary (funding relevance, license application vs. grant, AI-model announcement vs. banking-tied application) rather than just easy/obvious cases.
